chapter.5130108DC86DCC75.chapter_subtitl: Choose a plastic source, start Dissolution and branch into blocks, laser extraction, ore processing and mobs. Pink Slime and Ether Gas unlock the next machine frames.
Read top to bottom · hover a quest to see all its connections
Open a quest to inspect all prerequisites, including links to other chapters. Item tasks check inventory; the description explains assembly and a test run.

quest.5130110526994D7D.quest_desc: This pack's Material StoneWork Factory consumes an Advanced Frame, Resourceful Furnace and Block Breaker. Configure its operations, water, lava, FE and item output in the interface. The quest's item check does not inspect a completed configuration.
quest.5130110526994D7D.title: StoneWork: a single stone-processing station
quest.51301109BDC10F3A.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Processing Addon Tier 2 (industrialforegoing:processing_addon_tier_2). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301109BDC10F3A.title: Obtain 1 × Processing Addon Tier 2
quest.5130110CBA356673.quest_desc: The Fluid Laser Base works with charged Laser Drills and needs a clear fluid output. Its recipes depend on local conditions. The later Ether Gas route places the base directly above a Wither, as shown in the native guide.
quest.5130110CBA356673.quest_subtitle: The drill and two laser bases
quest.5130110CBA356673.title: Fluid Laser Base: fluid extraction
quest.51301110A6A327AA.quest_desc: Prepare the Ender IO Powered Spawner first, since this recipe consumes it. The Mob Duplicator then needs a filled Mob Imprisonment Tool, Essence and FE. Check the spawning space and the connected collection system.
quest.51301110A6A327AA.title: Sample + Essence → Mob Duplicator
quest.513011151DE90C52.quest_desc: The Fermentation Station handles the previous machine's Raw Ore Meat. Configure its mode and batch threshold, wait for the cycle and send the result to the Fluid Sieving Machine. Check the resource's recipe before mixing batches.
quest.513011151DE90C52.title: Fermenting the intermediate
quest.513011162F45B0CF.quest_desc: The Infinity Drill uses this branch's final frame. Inspect its recipe, charge storage and operating modes. Crafting it is a separate final use of the industrial line rather than a requirement for the earlier machines.
quest.513011162F45B0CF.title: Infinity Drill after the Supreme Frame
quest.5130111A5BD14B53.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Processing Addon Tier 1 (industrialforegoing:processing_addon_tier_1). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130111A5BD14B53.title: Obtain 1 × Processing Addon Tier 1
quest.5130111B4AB75BE7.quest_desc: The installed Industrial Foregoing Latex Processing Unit produces Dry Rubber directly. Each cycle uses 750 mB latex and 500 mB water plus FE. Supply the two fluids to their proper tanks and leave space for the solid output.
No Tiny Dry Rubber combining step is needed here. If the machine stops, check both fluid supplies, power, redstone control and its output slot.
quest.5130111B4AB75BE7.title: Plastic 2: latex + water + FE
quest.5130111BE9BBE0D5.quest_desc: The Pity Machine Frame starts latex extraction and basic utility machines. The central route goes through plastic and the Dissolution Chamber to higher frames; side stations supply fluids, blocks and by-products.
quest.5130111BE9BBE0D5.title: Pity Frame: the start of several lines
quest.5130111D6C11FBB1.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Range Addon Tier 5 (industrialforegoing:range_addon_tier_5). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130111D6C11FBB1.title: Obtain 1 × Range Addon Tier 5
quest.513011268D442A18.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Speed Addon Tier 2 (industrialforegoing:speed_addon_tier_2). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011268D442A18.title: Obtain 1 × Speed Addon Tier 2
quest.51301127D84254AF.quest_desc: The Supreme Frame needs an Advanced Frame, late materials and Ether Gas in the Dissolution Chamber. Establish the Fluid Laser Base line above a Wither as the native guide describes, with room for the setup and a product tank. Stabilize gas production before starting expensive frame batches.
quest.51301127D84254AF.title: Ether Gas → Supreme Frame
quest.51301137DA4E3B80.quest_desc: Collect Dry Rubber directly from the Latex Processing Unit. Smelt one rubber in a furnace to produce one Industrial Foregoing Plastic. Tiny Dry Rubber is deprecated in this version and is not needed for the line.
The existing task detects Dry Rubber without consuming it. The Plastic quest accepts the finished plastic from either this latex route or HDPE.
quest.51301137DA4E3B80.title: Plastic 3: Dry Rubber for smelting
quest.51301145D74317DD.quest_desc: The Laser Drill uses a Simple Frame and powers the operation of a separate Laser Base. Position the drill as the native guide specifies, connect FE and check that the base receives charge. The drill alone is not a complete production system.
quest.51301145D74317DD.quest_subtitle: The drill and two laser bases
quest.51301145D74317DD.title: Laser Drill: charge for the base
quest.51301150CDD6664E.quest_desc: The Dissolution Chamber itself uses a Pity Frame and plastic, so it does not need a Simple Frame first. Supply FE and the required fluid, arrange the recipe inputs and remove the result. This machine produces the later frames.
quest.51301150CDD6664E.quest_subtitle: Dissolution and the first three frames
quest.51301150CDD6664E.title: Dissolution Chamber before the Simple Frame
quest.51301154F33E4BE9.quest_desc: This tool holds a supported creature for compatible operations. The quest checks the empty item; the Mob Duplicator separately needs a prepared filled sample.
quest.51301154F33E4BE9.title: Mob Imprisonment Tool: a sample
quest.5130116264236136.quest_desc: The pack's recipe uses an Advanced Frame, Absorption Hopper and Mob Masher. Configure the working area, FE and separate item and Essence outputs. That Essence supplies the following mob duplication line.
quest.5130116264236136.title: Mob Crusher: loot and Essence
quest.513011652C2C4B48.quest_desc: The Mob Slaughter Factory starts from a Pity Frame and plastic. It produces fluid by-products, including Pink Slime for the Advanced Frame; provide separate outputs and capacity. It comes before the frame that consumes its reagent.
quest.513011652C2C4B48.quest_subtitle: Dissolution and the first three frames
quest.513011652C2C4B48.title: Pink Slime for frames
quest.5130116DDA11F4EE.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Efficiency Addon Tier 2 (industrialforegoing:efficiency_addon_tier_2). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130116DDA11F4EE.title: Obtain 1 × Efficiency Addon Tier 2
quest.51301171CA29CEF3.quest_desc: The Dissolution Chamber makes an Advanced Frame from a Simple Frame, plastic, Pink Slime and Dimensional Matrix stage components. It unlocks laser bases, ore processing and more complex farms; keep latex and slime production running.
quest.51301171CA29CEF3.quest_subtitle: Dissolution and the first three frames
quest.51301171CA29CEF3.title: Advanced Frame: the next production tier
quest.5130117AB9046CD2.quest_desc: The Enchantment Extractor transfers enchantments using its supported operations. Prepare items, books, FE and clear outputs for all results. It is a separate loot-processing branch after the Advanced Frame.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Diamond.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Enchantment Extractor. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.5130117AB9046CD2.title: Extracting enchantments
quest.5130118C29E5449C.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Range Addon Tier 2 (industrialforegoing:range_addon_tier_2). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130118C29E5449C.title: Obtain 1 × Range Addon Tier 2
quest.5130118E4A798482.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Mob Detector (industrialforegoing:mob_detector). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130118E4A798482.title: Obtain 1 × Mob Detector
quest.513011905E9962AB.quest_desc: In the Dissolution Chamber, combine a Pity Frame, plastic and precision components with latex as the recipe specifies. The Simple Frame supplies the Laser Drill and becomes the base of the Advanced Frame, so establish repeatable production.
quest.513011905E9962AB.quest_subtitle: Dissolution and the first three frames
quest.513011905E9962AB.title: Simple Frame with latex
quest.513011A2D8626B22.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Speed Addon Tier 1 (industrialforegoing:speed_addon_tier_1). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011A2D8626B22.title: Obtain 1 × Speed Addon Tier 1
quest.513011A48F738CFF.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Efficiency Addon Tier 1 (industrialforegoing:efficiency_addon_tier_1). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011A48F738CFF.title: Obtain 1 × Efficiency Addon Tier 1
quest.513011A514A41277.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Range Addon Tier 8 (industrialforegoing:range_addon_tier_8). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011A514A41277.title: Obtain 1 × Range Addon Tier 8
quest.513011B20346E7E1.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Range Addon Tier 11 (industrialforegoing:range_addon_tier_11). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B20346E7E1.title: Obtain 1 × Range Addon Tier 11
quest.513011C168D23426.quest_desc: The Fluid Sieving Machine uses the fermented product and sand to produce ore dust. Supply sand and FE and remove the results, then connect the appropriate smelting step.
quest.513011C168D23426.title: Fluid sieving → ore dust
quest.513011C5391BB59D.quest_desc: The Block Breaker harvests a supported block on its working side and needs room for the result. Pair it with a material supply for a local automated station; the machine is also an ingredient of the Material StoneWork Factory.
quest.513011C5391BB59D.title: Block Breaker: harvesting a block
quest.513011C62D389346.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Fluid Placer (industrialforegoing:fluid_placer). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011C62D389346.title: Obtain 1 × Fluid Placer
quest.513011D00529ECCA.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Water Condensator (industrialforegoing:water_condensator). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D00529ECCA.title: Obtain 1 × Water Condensator
quest.513011D0D111A20A.quest_desc: The Washing Factory consumes ore and Liquid Meat to begin fluid-based ore processing. Feed the Mob Slaughter Factory by-product into its tank and route the output to the Fermentation Station.
quest.513011D0D111A20A.title: Ore + Liquid Meat → Raw Ore Meat
quest.513011D4E145FBE3.quest_desc: Connect the Ore Laser Base to Laser Drills and route items into storage. Outputs depend on settings, depth, biome and lens; inspect the desired resource in JEI before choosing a site.
quest.513011D4E145FBE3.quest_subtitle: The drill and two laser bases
quest.513011D4E145FBE3.title: Ore Laser Base: choosing resources
quest.513011DB5BB9FB5B.quest_desc: Produce Industrial Foregoing Plastic using either route. Latex: Fluid Extractor → Latex Processing Unit → Dry Rubber → furnace → Plastic. Polymer: chapter 07, HDPE Sheet → SOQM recipe → 3 Plastic from one sheet.

Choose one available production route; this quest does not require both. Hold the finished plastic before crafting a Dissolution Chamber and later frames. The item check neither consumes it nor determines which production method you used.
quest.513011DB5BB9FB5B.title: Make Plastic: latex or HDPE
quest.513011EBEFDD9D81.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Block Placer (industrialforegoing:block_placer). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011EBEFDD9D81.title: Obtain 1 × Block Placer
quest.513011ECEDA27FBB.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Fluid Collector (industrialforegoing:fluid_collector). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011ECEDA27FBB.title: Obtain 1 × Fluid Collector
quest.513011ED4F8D85C3.quest_desc: The Enchantment Applicator completes the route from books to equipment. Supply a compatible item, enchanted book and the operating resources shown in its interface; farm Essence can support this system.
quest.513011ED4F8D85C3.title: Applying enchantments
quest.513011EEAB3DF77B.quest_desc: Place the Fluid Extractor beside a suitable log and route latex to a tank or Latex Processing Unit. Replenish the wood as it is consumed; without material on the working side, the rubber line stops.
quest.513011EEAB3DF77B.title: Plastic 1: extract latex
quest.513011F5C6B3A1A7.quest_desc: The Resourceful Furnace processes supported smelting recipes. Configure its item input, FE and output, and reserve another copy for the Material StoneWork Factory recipe.
quest.513011F5C6B3A1A7.title: Furnaces as an automated station
